preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the two required combat-readability gaps by introducing an occupancy-gated authoritative recovery transaction that unlocks the complete 3/5/10 enemy mission, then centralizing lifecycle navigation and player-facing terminology so checkpoint recovery, both result branches, replay, and home are reliably reachable at persisted 200% UI scale.

diagnosis.root_cause: Recovery authority is split across player-local spawn reset, mission checkpoint restoration, shell page routing, and delayed presentation handoff. That permits collision/input/page readiness to diverge and prevents an uninterrupted 3/5/10 enemy progression run. Repeated transform/reset tuning has not resolved the integration boundary. Separately, lifecycle navigation is distributed among button callbacks and terminal-presentation completion, while prohibited slash-style copy is generated from several mission, objective, and terminal paths rather than one reviewed presentation vocabulary.

stop_conditions: Stop if the preserved clean-boot baseline, intact authored arena, accepted viewmodels, or 18-enemy stable identity roster regresses.
Do not unlock gameplay when recovery lacks a committed mission receipt, all 18 actor receipts, a grounded collision-clear player destination, or a valid input handoff.
Stop a terminal transition if it duplicates damage, score, checkpoint state, leaderboard writes, or changes the preserved countdown.
Do not accept a shell state with missing keyboard/gamepad focus, unsafe 200% layout, prohibited slash-style player copy, or gameplay enabled behind a blocking page.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy: directly restore the existing player, weapon, and stable enemy instances through one mission-owned readiness transaction with collision/occupancy gates, rather than tuning transforms again. Drive shell pages from a centralized authoritative lifecycle table and reviewed presentation vocabulary instead of independent callbacks.

code: Parse and load the exact candidate project with no new script, resource, import, or runtime errors, and keep validate:clean_boot passing.
Assert recovery receipt invariants: one epoch, one snapshot source, 18 unique actor IDs, collision-clear grounded destination, monotonic timer, committed handoff, and idempotent rejection.
Assert F6 and checkpoint recovery use distinct commands and receipts, and run a scoped visible-string check that leaves no slash-slash decorative copy while ignoring paths and URIs.
Assert every lifecycle-table edge has an authoritative source, legal predecessor, focus target, input-lock predicate, and exactly-once transition/result receipt.

Host/Tester completes countdown-zero detonation→failure result→Replay→deployment and verifies collision-clear control, then exercises restart and return-home actions with keyboard and gamepad.
